source.title: Greater trochanteric pain syndrome: Evaluation and management of a wide spectrum of pathology
source.whyItFits: Open review that places trochanteric bursitis inside greater trochanteric pain syndrome and states that isolated bursitis is uncommon, with conservative care and corticosteroid injection results.
